package.name: racer_laps
package.description: Lap memory (plug-and-play part D): closes laps from a start-scan gate plus wheel odometry (no map after lap 1) or from the map to base_link pose, keeps a record of every lap, and advises the planner a speed cap that rises after clean laps and drops after unclean ones (D v0) or a per-station speed bound and cost to go learned from its own clean laps (D v1). It never publishes /drive_raw or /drive.
